feedback: This candidate has not yet been raced, so no telemetry data is available to confirm the effects of the current parameters. The controller uses a base_speed of 1.35, slightly reduced to improve stability and reduce aggressive driving. The kd gain is increased to 4.0 to enhance damping and reduce oscillations, while kp remains at 7 and ki at 0.35 to maintain responsiveness and integral correction. Sensor weights are adjusted to [-1.0, -0.8, 0, 0.8, 1.0], increasing the influence of the inner sensors for better steering precision while maintaining balance. The geometry remains unchanged, which is reasonable given no reported issues. Given the lack of telemetry and the limited remaining runs, I recommend approving this candidate to obtain race data that will inform further improvements. No additional changes are requested before racing.
